description: Defines the class interface for FramebufferGL, including methods for managing framebuffer state, reading pixels, blitting, and handling attachments in an OpenGL context within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: FramebufferGL
classes.description: OpenGL framebuffer implementation class managing framebuffer operations and state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the framebuffer object, releasing resources.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards specified attachments of the framebuffer.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates specified attachments of the framebuffer.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Invalidates a sub-region of specified attachments.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the framebuffer with specified mask.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with float values.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with unsigned int values.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with int values.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the framebuffer.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Performs a blit operation between framebuffers.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position of a sample.

methods.name: shouldSyncStateBeforeCheckStatus
methods.description: Indicates if a full sync is required before checking framebuffer status.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks the completeness status of the framebuffer.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the framebuffer state with the GL context.

methods.name: getFramebufferID
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL framebuffer object ID.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Indicates if this framebuffer is the default framebuffer.

methods.name: hasEmulatedAlphaChannelTextureAttachment
methods.description: Checks if the framebuffer has an emulated alpha channel texture attachment.
